description.subtitle: Arsenal 2025 2026 Men's adidas Training Short Sleeve Shirt - Turquoise
description.intro: Dominate every session in this adidas Arsenal 2025/2026 training shirt. Its design in vibrant turquoise and breathable fabric offers you the comfort and style you are looking for. Ideal for players and fans who want performance and club pride in one product. Look like a professional from the first touch!
key_benefits: Total comfort: Technical fabric that manages sweat to keep skin dry.
Gunner Inspiration: Official Arsenal training design 25/26.
Freedom of movement: Regular cut and light fabric that adapts to each play.
Eye-catching style: Teal color that stands out in the field and on the street.
Versatility: Perfect for training, playing sports or dressing casually with pride.
